headword: {無病息災|むびょうそくさい}

definitions.explanation: Being free of illness and living safely, mostly as something prayed or wished for.

examples.japanese: {無病息災|むびょうそくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
⟦{七草粥|ななくさがゆ}→七草粥：22751_nanakusagayu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{無病息災|むびょうそくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: We eat seven-herb porridge and wish for good health.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無病息災|むびょうそくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いする→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧。
examples.english: At New Year, we visit a shrine and pray for our family's good health.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧): {無病|むびょう} (no illness) + {息災|そくさい} (safe and well). It is used almost only with verbs of praying or wishing, at New Year and at seasonal festivals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無病息災|むびょうそくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧ / ⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧: to pray for good health
- {家内安全|かないあんぜん}・{無病息災|むびょうそくさい}: safety for the household and good health (a common wish on shrine charms)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一病息災|いちびょうそくさい}: "one illness, long life": someone with one chronic illness takes care and lives long
